query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(message_count), 0)::BIGINT AS "range_messages!",
               COALESCE(SUM(points), 0)::BIGINT AS "range_points!",
               COUNT(*) AS "range_sessions!",
               MAX(ended_at) AS "range_last?"
        FROM activity.text_conversation_log
        WHERE started_at >= $1
          AND user_id = $2
